reports.title: Atmos Energy Corporation Reports Earnings for Fiscal 2026;

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: •Fiscal 2027 earnings per diluted share guidance expected to be in the range of $9.05 - $9.25 per diluted share.
•Fiscal 2027 capital expenditure guidance expected to be approximately $4.5 billion.

•The company's Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.09 per common share. The indicated annual dividend for fiscal 2027 is $4.36, which represents a 9.0% increase over fiscal 2026.

desk.period: Fiscal 2026 (year to 30 Sep 2026); the release gives full-year figures only
desk.headline: FY26 EPS of $8.49 at the top of its twice-raised range; FY27 EPS guidance of $9.05–9.25 initiated and dividend up 9%
results: Full-year diluted EPS was $8.49 on net income of $1.4bn, the top of the $8.40–8.50 range the company had raised to during the year.
Capital spending reached $4.2bn, with more than 85% aimed at pipe safety and reliability.
Regulators approved $395.4m of annual rate increases during the year.
Balance sheet stays conservative: equity is 60% of capital and $3.8bn of liquidity is available.
Quarterly dividend raised to $1.09, or $4.36 a year (+9.0%).

guidance.summary: First outlook for fiscal 2027: EPS of $9.05–9.25, about 8% above FY26's $8.49 at the midpoint, with capital spending of about $4.5bn.

points: The five-year spending plan was lifted to about $29bn through FY2031, with an FY2031 EPS target of $12.35–12.55; the rate-base growth target was trimmed to 12–14% a year.
FY26 got one-off help from wide gas price spreads on the Texas pipeline and a large accounting deferral step-up; neither repeats, so FY27 growth must come from rate base and rate cases.
A further $264m of annual rate increases is already in place early in FY27; operating costs are guided roughly flat at $870–890m.
Pressures noted: slower cash recovery in Mississippi, about $500m of minimum-tax payments from FY27 and a planned $1.7bn at-the-market share sale programme.
call.source: Call coverage: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 5 Nov 2026 (no prepared remarks filed)

watch: Q1 FY27 earnings without last year's one-off pipeline spread gains.
Rate case outcomes, especially in Mississippi.
Pace of share issuance under the at-the-market programme to fund the larger capital plan.

sources.title: Atmos Energy Tops Estimates And Lifts Its Capex Runway, But FY27 Loses Last Year's One-Time Tailwinds — Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 5 Nov 2026
